## What's new
- **A quiet menu bar.** The Astronomical icon now stands alone by default. While a prompt is read or a picture is drawn, the icon itself shows how far along it is. If you'd like the old progress and speed text beside it, switch it on in Observatory's Settings or from the ⋯ button in the menu. - **A simpler menu.** The menu that opens from the icon now shows your model, what it's doing, how fast it reads and writes, how much memory it uses, and your memory limit. The detailed memory breakdown and build information are still there: switch on "Show technical details in the menu". - **A memory slider.** Set the most memory a model may use by dragging. A mark shows the loaded model's size, and a sentence tells you what your choice leaves for macOS and your other apps, or warns when part of the model will be read from the SSD. Drag it all the way right to use whatever your Mac allows. - **Reading and writing speed.** The menu shows how fast the model reads your prompts and writes its replies, averaged over the session, with the live speed while a reply is under way. - **A clear sign when something's wrong.** If Astronomical's engine stops answering, the icon shows an exclamation mark and "Not running", and the menu offers Restart. - **Slightly faster prompt reading** on mixture-of-experts models held fully in memory, with identical replies.
## Fixes
- The session's reading and writing speeds now weigh each request by how much it did, so a very short reply no longer skews them.
## Good to know
- Your conversations, models, settings and saved prompt work are all kept. - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - The app is signed with the project's Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
